fact: The Centrale d'adressage, set up at the BNETD, maintains the national address database (BD Adresse nationale); 11,521 plates and panels had been posted in the Abidjan district by end July 2025, and addressing has begun in Yamoussoukro, Korhogo and Daloa.
title: Adressage et Rénovation urbaine : la révolution en marche (BÂTIR, N°014)
publisher: Ministère de la Construction, du Logement et de l'Urbanisme
